summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release about resuming summer drilling at the Larocque East project after a wildfire-related pause. The release reports early drill results, including 43,160 cps over 0.5 m on the Hurricane South Trend, and outlines plans for 20 holes / 8,000 m of drilling. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is announced; the update is purely operational. As a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K, this does not constitute a special situation.
